What the data types mean

Daily discharge
One mean flow value per day. The most common record for hydrology homework (flow-duration curves, low flows, annual means).
Continuous discharge
Readings every 15 minutes or so (also called "instantaneous" or "unit values"). Online records usually start around 2007, even at older gages.
Annual peak discharge
The single highest flow in each water year (Oct 1 – Sep 30). Used for flood-frequency analysis.
Peaks only
Crest-stage gages: simple gages that record only the annual maximum. They have peak values but no daily or continuous record.
Data types available
Shows sites with any checked type. "Only peaks-only sites" shows sites with peaks but no daily or continuous record.
